description: This file defines interfaces for stream generators and their configurations used in Orleans streaming infrastructure, including methods for reading events and configuring generators.

classes.name: IStreamGenerator
classes.description: Interface for stream generator components that can attempt to read events and be configured with a generator configuration.

classes.name: IStreamGeneratorConfig
classes.description: Interface for generator configuration objects, providing minimal settings such as the generator type.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to read generated events given the current time and maximum count.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the stream generator with provided service provider and configuration.

methods.name: StreamGeneratorType
methods.description: Property that returns the type of the stream generator.
